messages:
sam ng: PR #8421 ready for merge — perf looks OK locally but CI microbench shows p95 +6% on 4k seq. Asking for 2 approvals, cc @chris @rita. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/8421/bench.html

rita: can you paste the short bench summary here? the artifact 404s for me earlier

sam ng: sure — trimmed microbench output (a4/8gpu run):
```
baseline (main): seq=4096 bs=16 p50=42ms p95=120ms throughput=760 tok/s mem=11.2GB
pr-8421 (branch): seq=4096 bs=16 p50=43ms p95=128ms throughput=730 tok/s mem=11.6GB
delta: p95 +8ms (+6.7%), throughput -4%, mem +400MB
```

chris: is this regression only on longseq? what tiling/batch config did you use? did you compare fp16 vs quantized runs?

sam ng: longseq-only so far. batch=16, tile=1024 (tiling tweak introduced in the PR). fp16 and int8-quant both show the bump. suspect prefetch ordering in the kv-shard iterator.

dev-bot: perf-check/job-8421 finished: regressions detected (p95:+6.7%). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/8421/bench.html

rita: can you run a targeted canary (10% traffic) instead of blocking, or do we need a HOLD?

chris: i'd prefer HOLD until we get a flamegraph. sam, can you upload a perf sample for a 4k seq run?

sam ng: uploaded flamegraph: s3://bench-artifacts/pr8421/flamegraph-4k.html

sam ng: quick local experiment: reverted a small prefetch reorder and p95 improved:
```
pr-8421-reverted-prefetch: p95=121ms throughput=755 tok/s mem=11.3GB
```

sam ng: short summary: regression is triggered by longseq tiling with the new prefetch order. reverting that line restores ~85% of lost perf. proposing we HOLD the merge until we land a small prefetch fix; alternative is merge behind a canary flag and monitor.

rita: HOLD then. request second approval after the revert/patch is in.

chris: ack. please open a follow-up PR with the revert + test and link here. also run microbench with batch=32 to confirm no other regressions.

sam ng: opening follow-up PR #8430 with revert + unit test. starting batch=32 run, will post numbers.

(10h later) sam ng: batch=32 run attached — after revert: p95=122ms, throughput=749 tok/s, mem=11.3GB. moving to request approvals again :thumbsup:

rita: thanks — will re-add to merge queue once #8430 merges and CI is green :+1:

chris: reviewed earlier, saving final approve for green CI. thanks!
